output.explanation: This request asks to delete data from marts.fct_orders. I can only write read-only SELECT queries, so I can't delete, update or otherwise change data. If you want cancelled orders out of your analysis, I can write a SELECT that leaves them out (for example by filtering on status or using is_revenue = true for revenue questions). I can also count or list the cancelled orders so you can review them first. To actually remove them from the warehouse, the change should go through the dbt model or source pipeline that builds this table.
